svg.desc: Where is plaintext visible, and which guarantees depend on trusted delivery or the host? Scope: Local unless explicitly F / G. No inferred mechanism; F nodes are future contracts, G nodes are gated code.
svg.title: HPX-DIAG-025 — Trust and plaintext boundaries
